description: Compare two texts line by line (Myers diff) and return a unified diff (3 lines of context, like `diff -u`), counts of added/removed/unchanged lines, and change blocks where each removed line is paired with the added line that replaced it and the changed words are marked [-old-] / {+new+}. Can ignore whitespace and case. Works with any language (Arabic included). Up to 50,000 lines per side. Web version: https://s3eidat.github.io/diff-view/

changedPath.description: Or: path to the changed text file.

ignoreCase.description: Treat lines that differ only in letter case as equal.

ignoreWhitespace.description: Treat lines that differ only in spacing as equal.

originalPath.description: Or: path to the original text file.

wordDiff.description: Mark the changed words inside paired lines (default true).

name: text_diff
title: Diff two texts
